== Description ==

[[Scott Lingrell]] (foreground, taking the selfie, short silver hair, glasses, navy baseball-style shirt), [[Jarad Konsker]] (navy New York Yankees cap, glasses, goatee, black tee with a yellow graphic, standing by a mic stand), [[Ken Cross]] (seated, grey and black Columbia fleece and rimless glasses), [[Spencer Gosiaco]] (standing, black Mariners cap and black jacket), [[Chris Wirfs]] (navy floral shirt, standing in the cluster), [[Nathan Davis]] (navy Mariners jersey, blue Seattle cap), and [[Ziemowit Skwara]] (glasses, short greying hair, black zip hoodie, name tag, facing the camera) at the [[2025 World Championship]] on 4 October 2025.
